Project_Dependency: Validated analytical findings informing Data Science feature selection and leakage review
Information_Received: Validated Data Analytics summary plus feature recommendations: supported/caveated/unsupported features, leakage warning for Diagnosis/Severity, time-safe PriorVisits/month/weekday suggestions, and no attendance/no-show field.
Information_Provided: Admission target source, 586 admitted / 4,414 non-admitted distribution, current 12-feature list, Week 6 candidate context and feature review sheet.
Testing_Activity_Completed: Defined prediction point as patient arrival before initial clinical assessment; removed Diagnosis/Severity and unvalidated demographics from the cross-track refinement; recalculated age at appointment; added time-safe PriorVisits, appointment month and weekday; retained FacilityID/DepartmentID with caveats; re-tested Gradient Boosting and balanced Logistic Regression.
Issue_or_Finding: Several features had prediction-time/data-quality concerns. Diagnosis and Severity may leak post-arrival clinical information. Attendance/no-show cannot be validated. Safer features did not provide strong admission discrimination.
Refinement_Action: Cross-track pre-assessment feature set: AgeAtAppointment, Gender, HasChronicCondition, VisitType, FacilityID, DepartmentID, PriorVisits, AppointmentMonth, AppointmentWeekday.
Retest_Result: Gradient Boosting holdout ROC-AUC=0.5189; 5-fold CV ROC-AUC=0.5237 +/- 0.0246. Balanced Logistic Regression holdout ROC-AUC=0.5024; CV ROC-AUC=0.4986 +/- 0.0322.
What_Changed: Feature governance improved and leakage risk was reduced; model suitability decision did not change because performance remained close to chance.
Overall_Improvement: Validated cross-track feature review completed. The refinement improved methodological safety and documentation, but did not validate an operationally useful model.
